1 ” to allow audio playback GRADE FOUR CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION PROGRAMME

2 ” to allow audio playback #Music# Hello, Learner. Welcome to grade four Christian Religious Education Program. Today, we shall talk about protecting yourself from sexual temptations. Protecting yourself from sexual temptations. The radio teacher is Purity Mukuhi . Welcome to the program. #Music#

3 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner. Today, we shall talk about protecting myself from sexual temptations. Before we start our lesson. What did we learn about the teachings of Jesus Christ? Learner, have you remembered about the teachings of Jesus Christ? #bell# I hope you mentioned the following. One: We should always forgive one another, as God has forgiven us, T w o: We should not revenge against those who are wrong us. Three: We should be willing to help those in need without choosing who to help. We should always consider the help they need from us. Four: We are special before God, even if we have sinned. Five: We should turn away from sin when we do that heaven rejoices. Six: God gives us the power of the Holy Spirit. That starts in a small way. As our faith grows, we are able to do great things for God's kingdom. #music# What is a temptation? A temptation is the desire to do or have something that you know is bad. As Christians, we all face temptations in our lives, as Jesus did. Learner, What would you do if someone tempted you do to have sex? #bell# We should always not give in to temptations.We must learn to resist any temptation as it is against God's will. Learner, do you have a Bible next to you? I will give you time to open Genesis 39:7 -12. Genesis 39:7 -12. #music# Learner,welcome back. Did you open Genesis 39:7 -12, good. Let's now read. Joseph was well-built and good looking. And after a while, his master's wife began to desire Joseph and asked him to go to bed with her. He refused and said to her. Look, my master does not have to concern himself with anything in the house because I am here. He has put me in charge of everything he has. I have as much authority in this house as he has and he has not kept back anything from me except you. How then could they do such an immoral thing and sin against God? Although she asked Joseph day after day, he would not go to bed with her. But one day when Joseph went into the house to do his work, none of the house servants was there. She caught him by his robe and said, come to bed with me. But he escaped and ran outside, leaving his robe in her hand.

4 ” to allow audio playback When we read Genesis 39: 7- 12. We learned that; One: Joseph worked for an Egyptian officer called Potiphar. T w o: Potiphar’s wife tried to force Joseph to sleep with her. Joseph refused and run out of the room. Three: Joseph had self-control. This helped him to keep off sexual sin. #music# I hope you have read Genesis 39: 7-12. Learner, Why did Potiphar trust Joseph? #bell# Learner, did you see that he saw the Lord was with Joseph? Good. Why did Joseph refuse to sleep with Potiphar’s wife? #bell# Learner, did you say that Joseph feared the Lord and that he had self-control? Very good. What happened to Joseph when his mustache came back? #bell# I hope you said that Joseph was put in prison. Joseph had self-control that helped him to keep off sexual sin. He also had a great trust in God. What have we learned today? #bell# Today, we have learned that: One: We should not give into sexual temptations. T w o: We should be careful when around people of the opposite sex. Three: We should not break other people's trust in us by doing bad things. Four: We can face sexual temptation from different people around us. Five: We should always say no to sexual temptations. We should keep off this temptation's and report to someone we trust. Six: We should avoid being in situations that can lead us to sexual sin. For example. Avoiding being alone with people of the opposite sex unless they are people we trust. #music# I hope you have enjoyed the lesson. Today we were talking about protecting yourself from sexual temptation. Learner, compose a poem on how you can resist sexual temptations let your parents or guardians guide you, remember to recite it to your siblings or close relatives and friends at home. That is the end of our lesson. #music#
